liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half Step** (2 reviews): Half Step and Franklin's Tower singled out as awesome; Half-Step opens at full power, followed by a full Franklin's Tower [7][8]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Reviewer ranks this among the very best Franklin's Towers they have heard [6]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Highlight with nice vocals from Donna [9]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Blistering, fun, loose-sounding performance; a highlight and danceable [9]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Final Not Fade Away and Goin' Down the Road are called pretty good [7]
- Reviewer says the jam leading into Shakedown is fat [5]

## The recordings

- **gd78-12-12.sbd-patched.cotsman.19895.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 151 min; rated 4.18/5 by 22 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound is not the best; reviewer had a better-sounding tape version; Soundboard is less clean than the October Winterland shows, but the concert was very high-energy [8][15]
- **gd78-12-12.wagner.minches.18511.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 158 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is pretty good, heard only on computer speakers; band energy is good; Encore has different sound quality; any tape flip in drums is not obvious [3][13]
- **gd1978-12-12.sbd.123741.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 2.12/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1978-12-12.sbd.clugston.4859.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [4]

## Around the show

- Attendee at their second show; calls it a Thanksgiving show and says the place rocked [5]
- Jerry had been sick and shows were cancelled for weeks after the Capitol Theater, Passaic show [10]
- First show back after a couple of weeks off; band sounded rested and high-energy [10]
- Reviewer worked at a Ft. Lauderdale record store and a coworker persuaded them to attend [11]
- Sounds fluffy by 77-78 standards, with steady, almost cheesy drumbeats and many first-set-type songs that can tire [7]
- Band always seems to bring it strong at Jai-Alai Fronton, as with the 6/22/74 performance [13]
- Sound quality trails the October Winterland shows [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-12-12.sbd-patched.cotsman.19895.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]
- **gd78-12-12.wagner.minches.18511.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by David Minches; source: Audience Recording: Sony 54Ps> Sony TC-158 [3]. Also: Audience recording by Wagner and Minches; presumed tape flip after Big River [3]
- **gd1978-12-12.sbd.123741.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat [2]
- **gd1978-12-12.sbd.clugston.4859.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > DAT > CDR [4]
